title: us house take up bill aimed curbing data center driven electricity costs 2026 09 10
text:
Sept 10 (Reuters) - Republican lawmakers plan to bring legislation to ​the House floor next ‌week that seeks to rein in electricity bill increases tied ​to data center ​expansion, a spokesperson for Speaker ⁠Mike Johnson said on ​Thursday.
The plan to hold ​a vote on the bipartisan Ratepayer Protection Act before the midterm ​elections was first ​reported by Axios.
"The bill will be ‌on ⁠the floor of the House next week," Taylor Haulsee, a spokesperson for Johnson, ​said ​in ⁠an email.
Government officials nationwide are under pressure ​to take steps ​to ⁠prevent the soaring cost of data center power needs ⁠from ​being passed ​on to average households.
